findings.text: The message tells every user to set `MIGRATION_CHECK_LEAN_SYSROOT`, but the installed entrypoint overwrites that variable (`build-support/runtime.nix:34`), so for an installed verifier this advice does nothing; `docs/install.md:33-35` already separates the two cases. Fix: tell installed users to reinstall the verifier, and limit the `MIGRATION_CHECK_LEAN_SYSROOT` advice to a development checkout, as `docs/install.md` does.
